text.title: Go HTTP Handlers (Gin / Echo / Chi / stdlib) Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a Go HTTP Handlers (Gin / Echo / Chi / stdlib) artefact from typed inputs.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `gohh-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/go-http-handlers.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Scaffold sub-procedure (expands steps 3 and 5 when the artefact ships real code)

step.name: server-skeleton
step.action: Copy `templates/server.go`: `Wire(cfg, deps)` returns `*http.Server` with all four timeouts; `Run(ctx, srv)` does ListenAndServe under an errgroup.
step.decision-gate: If the chosen framework is net/http, drop the Gin imports; otherwise adjust the middleware constructors.

step.name: middleware-order
step.action: Register: Recovery, RequestID, Logger, ErrorMapper (from `[[go-error-handling]]`), Auth, then domain middleware.
step.decision-gate: If Recovery is not outermost, panics produce blank 500s — CI grep rejects the misorder.

step.name: request-dto
step.action: Create `type XxxRequest struct { ... }` with `json` + `binding` tags, plus a `ToDomain()` method mapping to the model.
step.decision-gate: A field the client must never set (ID, timestamps, internal flags) does not belong in the `*Request` struct at all.

step.name: thin-handler
step.action: Handler does ShouldBindJSON → validate → `svc.X(c.Request.Context(), req.ToDomain())` → `c.JSON(status, result)`.
step.decision-gate: If the handler exceeds 40 lines, move the logic into the service before continuing.

step.name: graceful-shutdown
step.action: Listen for SIGINT/SIGTERM with `signal.NotifyContext`; on signal call `srv.Shutdown(ctx)` with a 10-15s drain, then cancel the root context.
step.output: main.go wires `Run(ctx, srv)` and exits cleanly.
step.decision-gate: If `srv.Shutdown` returns `context.DeadlineExceeded`, raise the drain window or find the hanging handler.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
